name: Karuna Medical College Hospital
tagline: Private multi‑speciality teaching hospital on the Karuna Medical College campus
summary: A 500–600+ bed private multi‑speciality teaching and emergency hospital at Vilayodi, Chittur, attached to Karuna Medical College and serving Palakkad taluk.
description: Karuna Medical College Hospital is the on‑campus teaching hospital of Karuna Medical College at Vilayodi (PO), Chittur, Palakkad. The hospital functions as a multi‑speciality tertiary care and teaching centre for the region.
It provides inpatient, emergency and critical care services across a range of specialties and super‑specialties and supports the college's MBBS and postgraduate training programmes.

The hospital matters locally because it is a major private referral centre in eastern Palakkad district, offering ICU/NICU facilities, operation theatres, radiology and laboratory services to surrounding rural and border communities.

Visitors (patients and families) find 24x7 emergency services, speciality clinics and an on‑campus clinical environment where treatment is integrated with medical teaching; confirm specific services or empanelments with the hospital before travel.
highlights: On‑campus teaching hospital for Karuna Medical College (Vilayodi, Chittur).
Multi‑speciality and several super‑specialty departments including cardiology, neurosurgery, nephrology and oncology (hospital listing).
24x7 emergency and critical‑care services with ICU/NICU facilities.
College recognised by the National Medical Commission; MBBS intake listed as 150 (NMC 2026 seat matrix).
Blood‑bank / blood‑centre and in‑house laboratory services (confirm current accreditations before use).

sections.heading: Background
body: Karuna Medical College Hospital began as the Karuna Hospital on the Karuna Institute campus and later expanded as the teaching hospital for Karuna Medical College (established mid‑2000s). The campus is managed by the Safe Development Alms Trust and is affiliated to the Kerala University of Health Sciences.

The hospital operates as the principal clinical training site for the college’s MBBS and postgraduate programmes and serves a wide rural catchment in Palakkad district and neighbouring Tamil Nadu border areas.

sections.heading: Clinical services and facilities
body: The hospital is listed as a large multi‑speciality teaching hospital with extensive inpatient capacity (reported at around 500–600 beds). It advertises speciality and super‑speciality services (medicine, surgery, obstetrics & gynaecology, paediatrics, orthopaedics, cardiology, neurosurgery, urology, oncology and others) along with modern operation theatres, imaging and dialysis.

Emergency care operates 24x7 with dedicated ICU/NICU capacity and laboratory/diagnostic support. Patients should confirm availability of specific services, bed categories and any empanelment (for insurance/state schemes) before arrival.

sections.heading: Teaching, accreditation and courses
body: Karuna Medical College is an NMC‑listed medical college; the attached hospital supports undergraduate and a small number of postgraduate seats. NMC records show the college listed with 150 MBBS seats in the 2026 seat matrix and several small MD/MS postgraduate allocations (check NMC/college notices for year‑specific permission).

Laboratory and other service accreditations can change; confirm NABL or other laboratory accreditation status and current approvals directly with the hospital or through official regulator listings before relying on them for specialised testing.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: Address the hospital reception on arrival and carry ID and medical records. For scheduled admissions or speciality appointments, call ahead to confirm clinician availability, bed category and insurance or state‑scheme empanelment.

If you are travelling from outside Palakkad district, use Palakkad/Palakkad Town or Chittur as regional transit hubs and plan local road transport to Vilayodi (confirm exact gate/entrance with hospital staff).

latest.text: NMC records and public college listings show Karuna Medical College listed with an approved MBBS intake of 150 seats for the 2026–27 academic year (LOP/increase recorded in NMC lists).
Kerala health / GHIS listings include Karuna Medical College Hospital in the 2026–27 hospital list for the state’s health information system updates.

visitorInfo.bestTime: Open year‑round; emergency services operate 24x7—call ahead for elective admissions or speciality clinics.
visitorInfo.howToReach: By road from Palakkad or Chittur: use state buses or private taxis to Vilayodi (Chittur taluk). Nearest major railhead is Palakkad (Palakkad Junction); confirm last‑mile directions with the hospital before travel.
etiquette: Call the hospital reception before you travel to confirm speciality clinic timings, bed availability and empanelment for insurance/state schemes.
Carry photo ID and copies of prior medical records or imaging; admissions and investigations are faster with documents ready.
If you are a relative planning to stay, ask about visitor timings and on‑campus facilities; enquire about language preferences (Malayalam/English) when booking.
For students or applicants, check the NMC seat/permission notices and the college website for the current academic year before applying.
